CZ Responds to BNB Chain’s New L1 Plan: “Multiple chains, one coins” CZ responds to BNB Chain’s updated New L1 plans: “Multiple chains, one coins.” According to BNB Chain docs updated on Oct 22, the new L1 (name TBD) will run in parallel with BSC via a native bridge and will not issue a separate token. It continues using BNB for gas, staking, and governance. Target specs include ~200ms blocks and ~20ms pre-confirmation. An internal multi-validator devnet is already running; public testnet is planned for end of 2026 and mainnet for early 2027. — link

Ethereum ICO Whale Moves 5,000 ETH After Holding for Around 11 Years, Sends 1,500 ETH to Exchanges According to EmberCN, an Ethereum ICO whale transferred 5,000 ETH within two hours, including 1,500 ETH worth approximately $3.45M to centralized exchanges. The whale acquired 100,000 ETH in 2015 at $0.311 each, costing approximately $31K, and sold 50,000 ETH in 2016 at $5.47 each for approximately $274K. The remaining 50,000 ETH had been held until these transfers began. — link

MEXC winds down Netherlands, expands restricted-market list MEXC Lacks MiCA Authorization, Winds Down Netherlands as Restricted-Market List Expands MEXC said it does not hold MiCA authorization in the EU and EEA and is winding down services in the Netherlands, with final offboarding scheduled for November 16. The exchange is also discontinuing services for users in Russia and Belarus. Separately, its User Agreement currently lists 13 prohibited jurisdictions, including the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Singapore, Hong Kong, Mainland China, Malaysia and Kazakhstan. — link

Singapore Gulf Bank's parent appoints Revolut chairman to advisory board Asia Gulf Holdings, parent of Bahrain-licensed Singapore Gulf Bank, appointed Revolut Group chairman Martin Gilbert and former Singapore minister Maliki Osman to its Global Advisory Board. Gilbert will advise on investment strategy and asset management across Asia and the Middle East, while Osman will focus on geopolitics and government relations. — link
